artisticRule: From measure 104 onward, a Shadow logical lane may illuminate only while one or more performed notes in its mapped V36 material sound.

coordinateSystems.authoritativeHere: V36 score measure/beat and cumulative-quarter coordinates
coordinateSystems.performanceTime: Not encoded; bind only to an approved conductor/audio playback clock

deploymentContract.replicationPolicy: A logical lane may be replicated to assigned devices without brightness stacking

semanticRoutingPolicies.ties: merge only exact adjacent same-pitch starts/stops
semanticRoutingPolicies.chordsAndDivisi: binary OR; simultaneous notes do not increase brightness
semanticRoutingPolicies.sharedUnisons: deduplicate only in lane state; retain all source noteheads

supplementalSourceVoices.evidence: Every event is exactly concurrent with a P3 voice-1 span
supplementalSourceVoices.laneEffect: provenance only; binary lane output and brightness are unchanged

tieResolutions.resolution: Cap the old pitch at its encoded end and begin the adjacent different pitch as a separate event. Binary lane OR leaves no off transition at the shared boundary.
